entities.name: Julius Caesar
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Roman general and statesman (100–44 BCE) who conquered Gaul, crossed the Rubicon, and became dictator of Rome. His assassination triggered civil wars that ended the Roman Republic and led to the Roman Empire under Augustus.
